in_sanskrit.name: धिषणा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: धिष्णुकाय (dhishnukaya) - The one who is the object of adoration, reverence, and devotion.

in_hindi.name: धिषणा
in_hindi.long_meaning: धिष्टा (dhishhta) - The one who is cherished, adored, and revered.

in_tamil.name: திஷனா
in_tamil.long_meaning: திஷ்டா (tishtaa) - The one who is desirable, precious, and valuable.

in_telugu.name: ధిష్ణా
in_telugu.long_meaning: ధిష్టా (dhishhta) - The one who is cherished, adored, and revered.

in_marathi.name: Dhishana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhishana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Dhishana is the goddess of prosperity and abundance. Her name comes from the Sanskrit word ‘dhisana’, which means ‘auspiciousness’ or ‘shining’. She is often depicted holding a lotus flower, symbolizing creation and rebirth.
